messages.subject: Tirathai | Power equipment, energy transition and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Tirathai Leadership Team,

Tirathai's position in transformer manufacturing and power infrastructure aligns strongly with my experience across regulated industry, energy transition and stakeholder execution.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness and regulator coordination.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a Tirathai-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
